definitions.gloss: shareholdings; stocks one owns; equity holdings
definitions.explanation: Shares of stock that a person or entity currently holds or owns.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{株|かぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{株|かぶ}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧だ。
examples.english: The president's shareholding ratio is thirty percent.

examples.japanese: {従業員|じゅうぎょういん}{持|も}ち{株|かぶ}{会|かい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}して→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧、⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}っている→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I joined the employee stock ownership plan and buy a little company stock each month.

notes:
USAGE:
{持|も}ち{株|かぶ} refers to shares one currently holds. It is common in business and financial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{株|かぶ}{会社|がいしゃ} (holding company)
- {持|も}ち{株|かぶ}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧ (shareholding ratio)
- {従業員|じゅうぎょういん}{持|も}ち{株|かぶ}{会|かい} (employee stock ownership plan)
- {持|も}ち{株|かぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to sell one's shares)
- {持|も}ち{株|かぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ (to increase one's shareholdings)
